headline: 泰柳萊影展多部新片影評
context: 美國泰柳萊影展（Telluride Film Festival）近日釋出多部新片影評，包括探討酷兒藝術史的紀錄片《Act 3》，以及麥克．李（Mike Leigh）描寫親情老去的新作《Tender Loving Care》。多部作品都獲得影評正面評價。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Telluride film festival Christine Molloy and Joe Lawlor’s absorbing documentary is a parallel take on their relationship and a nascent drama on artists Claude Cahun and Marcel Moore Christine Molloy and Joe Lawlor are artists and film-makers from Ireland who have created eerie and suspenseful psychological dramas in parallel with a strand of complex and self-questioning essay movies. They explore ideas about history and identity, ruminating on their creative selves and metatextually examining (or re-examining) their own work. You may call it the “Alfred Hitchcock” and “Chris Marker” sides to their work. Sometimes, their documentaries act as a kind of commentary on the fiction feature they are developing at the same time: like The Future Tense, a film about the ideas encountered during a planned movie about the pro-IRA English heiress Rose Dugdale, a project which came to fruition as the drama Baltimore . Now, they have made a strangely mesmeric, deeply personal, mysteriously stylised film called Act 3, which may itself yet herald a conventional drama about its notional subject. It is structured around Molloy and Lawlor having a weirdly self-aware dialogue about their lives together over 40 years, filmed singly in shot-reverse-shot (was each holding the camera on the other?) but speaking quietly and slowly, as if under hypnosis. sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Telluride film festival Alice Bailey Johnson and Kate O’Flynn lead a complicated, quietly heartbreaking drama about friendship, ageing parents and the sadness of lives moving inexorably on Mike Leigh’s new film – perhaps his last – is a poignant, intergenerational drama of happy-sad acceptance that life goes on, until it doesn’t go on. And then you have to come to terms with the mortality of your elderly parents and by that same token, with the end that is waiting for you too. The decency and clarity of the film are a tonic. It is a movie with one of Leigh’s overtly positive and even sugary titles, like Life Is Sweet (1990) or Happy-Go-Lucky (2008), as distinct from his darker ones: Secrets & Lies (1996) or Hard Truths (2024). But his sweet titles are not simply satirical and intended to mean the opposite: it is more complicated and elusive, and even the contrast here between the two heroines’ private and professional lives isn’t straightforwardly a matter of irony. As so often, the dialogue has that unique Leigh cartoonish quality that isn’t caricature, and the characters often speak with an almost wartime chirpiness in a world of peckers kept up and noses kept clean. This is a perkiness that the thirtysomethings have unexpectedly inherited and modified from their old mum and dad, and Leigh leaves it to the audience to judge the consequent tone of the drama and the appropriate tone of their response. thread_text:
美國泰柳萊影展（Telluride Film Festival）近日釋出多部新片的影評。《Act 3》是一部沉浸式紀錄片，導演克莉絲汀．莫洛伊（Christine Molloy）與喬．勞勒（Joe Lawlor）用對話形式，回顧自己四十年的創作與感情關係，同時帶出酷兒藝術家克勞德．卡恩（Claude Cahun）與馬塞爾．摩爾（Marcel Moore）的故事。麥克．李（Mike Leigh）可能的最後一部作品《Tender Loving Care》，描寫姊妹面對年邁父母、接受生命終將流逝的心境，影評形容整部片誠實而清楚。安德魯．海格（Andrew Haigh）執導的西部片《A Long Winter》同樣得到不少讚譽，重聚演唱會紀錄片《Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger》，也捕捉到樂迷久別重逢的悸動。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 5 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 泰柳萊影展這幾天，好幾部新片的影評出爐了。紀錄片《Act 3》用對話形式，回顧兩位導演四十年的創作與感情關係，同時帶出酷兒藝術家克勞德．卡恩與馬塞爾．摩爾的故事。麥克．李可能的最後一部作品《Tender Loving Care》，講的是姊妹面對年邁父母、接受生命終將流逝的心境，影評說這部片誠實又清楚。安德魯．海格執導的西部片《A Long Winter》也得到不少讚譽，重聚演唱會紀錄片《Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger》，則捕捉到樂迷久別重逢的悸動。
